grid.expression: SELECT FIN.NUNOTA AS NUNICO, FIN.NUFIN AS NFINANCEIRO, FIN.NUMNOTA AS NRNOTA, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, FIN.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.DTVENC, FIN.DHBAIXA, FIN.VLRBAIXA FROM TGFFIN FIN INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN) AND FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR FIN.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND NVL(FIN.NUFIN,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'F') AND NVL(FIN.NUNOTA,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'E') UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT FN.NUNOTA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS NUNICO, F.NUFIN AS NFINANCEIRO, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.NUMNOTA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS NRNOTA, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.CODPARC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS CODPARC, (SELECT P.RAZAOSOCIAL FROM TGFPAR P WHERE P.CODPARC = (SELECT DISTINCT FN.CODPARC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN)) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, F.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT NA.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT NA WHERE NA.CODNAT = F.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DTNEG FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS DTNEG, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DTVENC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS DTVENC, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUFIN = F.NUFIN) AS DHBAIXA, F.VLRBAIXA FROM (SELECT RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'F') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN)) F UNION ALL SELECT C.NUFIN AS NUNICO, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.NUNOTA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS NFINANCEIRO, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.NUMNOTA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS NRNOTA, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.CODPARC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS CODPARC, (SELECT P.RAZAOSOCIAL FROM TGFPAR P WHERE P.CODPARC = (SELECT DISTINCT FN.CODPARC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN)) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, C.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT NA.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT NA WHERE NA.CODNAT = C.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DTNEG FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS DTNEG, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DTVENC FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS DTVENC, (SELECT DISTINCT FN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFFIN FN WHERE FN.NUNOTA = C.NUFIN) AS DHBAIXA, C.VLRBAIXA FROM (SELECT RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUNOTA AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'E') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN)) C

SELECT DISTINCT R.CODNAT, (SELECT DISTINCT N.DESCRNAT FROM TGFNAT N WHERE N.CODNAT = R.CODNAT) AS DESCRNAT, SUM(R.VLRBAIXA) AS VLRBAIXA FROM (SELECT FIN.CODNAT, SUM(FIN.VLRBAIXA) AS VLRBAIXA FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR FIN.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN) AND NVL(FIN.NUFIN,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'F') AND NVL(FIN.NUNOTA,0) NOT IN (SELECT R.NUFIN FROM TGFRAT R WHERE R.ORIGEM = 'E') GROUP BY FIN.CODNAT UNION ALL SELECT TB1.CODNAT, SUM(TB1.VLRBAIXA) AS VLRBAIXA FROM (SELECT RAT.ORIGEM, RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA, FIN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUFIN AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'F') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN) UNION ALL SELECT RAT.ORIGEM, RAT.NUFIN, RAT.CODNAT, ROUND(((RAT.PERCRATEIO/100) * FIN.VLRBAIXA),2) AS VLRBAIXA , FIN.DHBAIXA FROM TGFRAT RAT INNER JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON (RAT.NUFIN = FIN.NUNOTA AND RAT.ORIGEM = 'E') WHERE FIN.PROVISAO = 'N' AND FIN.RECDESP = -1 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL AND (:P_CODNAT IS NULL OR RAT.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT) AND (TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) >= :P_BAIXA.INI AND TRUNC(FIN.DHBAIXA) <= :P_BAIXA.FIN)) TB1 GROUP BY TB1.CODNAT) R GROUP BY R.CODNAT ORDER BY R.CODNAT
